adapter_policy: Read-only host deployment configuration. Explicit selection by registration id, no fallback. Paths are private installation locations, never project or media identities.
decoder_goal: Final target is a replaceable capability chain: hardware/GPU adapters first when saved source facts are explicitly supported, then system decoder adapters, then external/software adapters. FFmpeg is the approved interim external adapter until QNC is functional and stable; it must remain replaceable and must not be hardcoded in player, filmstrip, UI or shell.
